title: Scp-022 The Morgue
style: inside a stuck elevator, brushed metal walls, flickering light, doors half open onto darkness between floors, photorealistic, absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no timestamps, no watermarks, vertical composition

credit.author: DrSevere
credit.line: Based on SCP-022 by DrSevere - scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-022 - CC BY-SA 3.0

post_caption: A morgue drawer slides open and the dead get up. Would you step inside to look?

Hero.look: short auburn hair, dark Foundation jacket, seen from behind, no face

scenes.image_prompt: Wide dark photograph of a stuck elevator, doors half open onto black. Far away in the gap, a faint tall sheeted corpse shape. Large empty dark area at top. One flickering ceiling light, photorealistic, {style}

lines.text: A drawer slides open in a hospital basement, and the body under the sheet begins to wake. This morgue in Britain is alive.

scenes.label: WHAT IT DOES
scenes.image_prompt: Photograph inside a stuck elevator, doors half open onto black. A corner of stained white morgue sheet trails across the floor. No figure visible. One flickering light, cold steel, photorealistic, {style}

lines.text: After six minutes it rises and tries to leave. It never breathes, and even without its head, the body keeps moving.

scenes.label: WHY IT'S DANGEROUS
scenes.image_prompt: Photograph of elevator buttons all lit in a dark stuck elevator, the glow the only light. Pale cold fingerprints on the metal, a stained white sheet scrap caught in the half-open doors. No figure, photorealistic, {style}

lines.text: And they are real, matching bodies stolen from morgues across the country.

scenes.label: HOW IT'S CONTAINED
scenes.image_prompt: Photograph from inside a stuck elevator, doors half open onto black. Far down the corridor, a heavy steel vault door catches one flickering light. Tiny pale sheeted shape barely visible, photorealistic, {style}

lines.text: So the Foundation, a secret group that locks away things that should not exist, sealed it behind a vault door.

scenes.label: WHO WATCHES IT
scenes.image_prompt: Photograph of a dark stuck elevator, a small security camera dome glowing in one corner as the only light. Far through the half-open doors, a tall sheeted pale corpse partly hidden in black, photorealistic, {style}

lines.text: Now cameras watch for any body that walks out, and automated systems burn it the moment it leaves.

scenes.label: THE MISTAKE
scenes.image_prompt: Photograph from behind: the back of {Hero} standing in a stuck elevator, doors half open onto black. Far ahead, a tall pale sheeted corpse partly hidden. One flickering light, photorealistic, {style}

lines.text: But tonight you are on watch, and a drawer opens. You step inside to look, against orders.

scenes.image_prompt: Photograph of a stuck elevator, light flickering, doorway different now. A tall stiff pale grey sheeted corpse stands closer beyond the half-open doors, face covered, mostly dark. One light, photorealistic, {style}

lines.text: Anything inside reappears upstairs after 183 seconds. But you never do. The morgue has kept you.

scenes.image_prompt: Photograph of a tall pale grey corpse under a stained white sheet, face covered, filling the gap of elevator doors, very close but in darkness, lit by one flicker, partly out of focus, photorealistic, {style}

lines.text: Six minutes, then we rise, cold hands, no breath, no sighs. Step inside, stay with me, soon you'll walk as we.

archivist_note: TAPE 15  -  The narrator says a name I did not hear the first time.
